why: A figure standing upright in the mist while the people around them stoop, under a low sun. Holding your purpose under pressure.
A woman working at a loom in lamplight, not talking. The action that works when words don't.
People drawing water from a stone well with a bucket on a rope. The well and the rope, literally.
Spring water falling from mossy rocks in a forest. The water is always there.
A length of cloth finished on the loom beside a lamp. The work completed first.
Two robed figures exchanging a token while a crowd watches. The trust that comes at the end.
A bronze caldron steaming over a fire. The Caldron, literally.
A farmer ploughing a field behind an ox. Getting the ground ready before anything is planted.
A figure climbing a long flight of stone steps toward a gate. Step by step.
A big tree in a field next to rows of young seedlings, with a farmer hoeing. Slow growth that lasts.
A young woman at a wall looking out over mist toward a distant tower. Looking ahead to the end.
Two people walking out of a dark gorge toward a sunlit valley. This part won't last.
A deer grazing calmly on a mountain ledge. Untroubled, nothing to worry about.
A figure with arms spread under a bright sun over a valley, birds overhead. Be the sun at noon.
A rider on horseback coming through a town gate. A traveller passing through.
A guest bowing and offering a gift to the host at a doorway. Acting like a guest.
Two dogs squaring off in a courtyard. The argument the line warns against.
An elder at the centre of his family around a table under blossoms. Where they come from.
A man ladling a measured amount of water from a well into jars. Setting limits.
A robed figure standing calm and upright in the mountains. Firm, but not bitter.
Two people sitting side by side watching the sunset. Understanding someone first.
A man kneeling before an official writing at a desk. Judgement, which the line says to hold off on.
A farmer bent over planting rice by hand in a paddy. Small work, no big moves.
A man kneeling by a stream holding a small stone carefully in both hands. Something small, done well.
A figure shading their eyes, looking out over a village at dusk. Staying alert.
An armoured knight standing ready with a sword in the evening light. Prepared while things still work.
A lone traveller with a stick on a long road at night, the destination far off. Not yet there.
An old man sorting papers at his desk by the window. Sorting things out before you move.
